annotations.title: Update or turn on a comment-to-get trigger

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Changes a trigger; only the fields you pass change. `active: true` makes it reply to and DM real people from then on and needs the publish scope: confirm with the user first. `active: false` pauses it.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/growth-triggers/{id}.)

accountId.description: A connected account id (GET /api/v2/accounts); omitted = every account of the brand.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

campaignKey.description: utm_campaign for {{link}}, and the campaign column of the logs.

delaySeconds.description: Wait before replying; capped at 20 at send time.

dmText.description: Private reply (Instagram and Facebook only; refused on an account of another platform).

keywords.description: Case-insensitive. exact = the whole comment; startsWith = its start; contains = anywhere (substring, so "hi" also matches "this").

maxSends.description: After this many sends, reply only overCapText.

postIds.description: Only comments on these posts; omitted = all posts.

priority.description: Higher is checked first; the first matching trigger wins.

replyText.description: Public reply. {{name}} = the commenter, {{link}} = `link` with UTM tags. Must not contain a keyword (it would trigger itself).

replyVariations.description: Alternatives picked at random with replyText.
